description: M1 Knowledge Base seed — curated DNA objects, visualization rules, layout rules, and tuned domain classifier for the iDash AI Brain pipeline

changes: Added 5 new domain packs: logistics_transport, hotel_hospitality, marketing_digital, ecommerce_retail, education — each with full lexicon (TH/EN/LO), valueShapes, unitPatterns, negative signals, business processes, personas, and decision catalogs
Added 51 new KPI definitions across the 5 new domains (total 114 KPIs)
Cross-pack negative signals expanded: all 12 packs now carry negatives for adjacent domains to prevent false positives
Profiler robustness: multi-sheet parsing (picks sheet with most data), duplicate column name handling, cross-tab/matrix format detection
Domain pack IDs registered in app.js, theme.js, and eval harness

Classifier accuracy 85.7% -> 100.0% on the 98-dataset corpus by removing over-generic lexicon terms that caused cross-domain false positives (hr_people: "review"/"rating"/"status"/bare "performance" sheet term; sales_crm: bare "order"/"delivery" sheet term)

Added negative-signal groups so specific packs correctly defer to generic_business on adjacent-but-uncovered domains: SaaS (arpu/mrr variants), education (tuition/enrolled/instructor/dropout), hospitality (occupancy/adr/revpar), logistics (on_time/damaged/cost_per_delivery), marketing (bounce_rate/conversions/sessions), crypto/DeFi (protocol/chain/apy/staking), environmental AQI (pm25/pollutant), customer support (csat/handle_time)
sugar_factory: added fertilizer/pesticide/water-usage filename signals to catch agricultural-input tracking sheets that only carry generic column headers
Net effect: raw ranking now trusts specific-domain wins only when real domain vocabulary is present, and falls back to generic_business on accidental single-keyword overlaps
Domain packs: added strategic negatives to all 6 specific packs (25+ false-positive domains covered)
Domain packs: expanded sugar_factory Thai farming lexicon, manufacturing maintenance terms, generic_business universal EN terms
Classifier: word-boundary matching for short ASCII terms to prevent false substring matches
Classifier: softmax confidence from exp(rawScore) over top-5 packs
Eval harness: refactored to use official classifier.js instead of inline duplicate
